facts.fact: Mozambique's ATDI says procurement of a national mobile digital ID and digital signature infrastructure, for identification, authentication and electronic signatures under the World Bank-financed EDGE project, has a shortlist submitted to the World Bank, with contracting planned for September 2026.
facts.system: National mobile digital ID and digital signature infrastructure (EDGE)

systems.system: National mobile digital ID and digital signature infrastructure (EDGE)

MOZ.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No statement on a number given at birth.
Operation and ownership of a national ID system are not stated.
The NUIT is named as a taxpayer number for portal services, not as a register keyed on a national ID number.

facts.fact: ATDI is developing a national digital ID project as part of the digital government architecture, and the EDGE mobile digital ID procurement has a shortlist submitted to the World Bank with contracting planned for September 2026.
